shortlist.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive and CD56-positive, consistent with this lymphoma subtype

shortlist.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: CD138-positive and EBV-positive, consistent with this lymphoma subtype

shortlist.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6) and 14q32 (IGH), which can be seen in this lymphoma subtype

shortlist.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive presentation with a large polypoid mass and lack of metastatic disease

shortlist.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, with EBV-positive and CD56-positive, but with a more specific nasal cavity location

raw.rationale: The presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, along with EBV positivity and the absence of CD20 and PAX5 expression, are characteristic of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. The gains of fluorescence signal at multiple loci, including 3q27 (BCL6), 8q24 (MYC), and 14q32 (IGH), also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Plasmablastic lymphoma
rejected.why: CD20 and PAX5 negativity does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: CD20 and PAX5 negativity, along with EBV positivity, does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: The presence of CD138 and CD56 positivity, along with EBV positivity, is more characteristic of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma

rejected.label: Nasal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma
rejected.why: This is another term for Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, but Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma is the preferred term
